transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I came in because... I just can't stop worrying. About... well, everything at once, really. 

My marriage... whether I'm slipping at work. Bills. The house projects I just keep dropping. It's... I don't know, I just constantly worry that I'm basically failing as a husband and a father. So... yeah. That's what brings me in.
Have you been avoiding any situations or activities because of your worries?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I still go to work and... you know, do what I have to do. I just... worry while I'm doing it.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
No. I mean... I wouldn't say sad. Just... stressed, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your physical health lately, such as headaches or stomach problems?
Um... no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed any headaches or... stomach things. Physically, I'm pretty much fine.
Has something very upsetting or traumatic happened to you recently?
Um... no. Nothing like that. Just... normal day-to-day stuff, I guess.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and are difficult to control?

I guess... yeah. It's hard to stop them once they start. Like, I'll be trying to just focus on the code I'm writing, or... or even just working out, trying to breathe, and then... one worry just kind of grabs onto another one. And before I know it, I'm... I'm way down the line, thinking about how a bad performance review is going to get me fired, and then... how I won't be able to provide for my family. It just... it spirals, I suppose.
Do you feel compelled to perform specific rituals or behaviors to reduce your worries?
No. Um... not really. I don't... I don't do any rituals or anything like that.
Are your worries usually about a specific type of thing, like money or relationships, or do they seem to be about everything and anything?

Um... I suppose it's... it's pretty much everything. Just all at once, really. I can't seem to stop it. 

It's... you know, my marriage... whether I'm slipping at work... bills. Even just... house projects I keep dropping. I just... I don't know. I guess I just worry that I'm basically failing as a husband and a father. So... yeah. It's not just one thing.
Have you ever felt hopeless about your future?
No... not hopeless, really. Just... tired. I mean, I don't think things are doomed or anything. I just... I worry a lot. That's all.
Do you have thoughts that are intrusive or unwanted, and that you try to suppress or ignore?

No, not really. I mean... I worry about the things I mentioned, but it's not like... I don't know, weird thoughts popping into my head out of nowhere. It's just the normal stuff I stress about, just... a lot of it. I don't really try to ignore it, I just can't stop thinking about it.
How long have you been experiencing these excessive worries?

Um... about nine months, I think. Give or take. It sort of... started getting worse when this big cloud migration project ramped up at work. And... well, around the time the arguments at home started becoming a regular thing. So... yeah. About nine months.
Are your worries making it harder for you to concentrate or complete tasks at work or at home?

Yeah... I guess they are. At work, my manager actually started... documenting things. Like, missed architectural details. I just... I can't focus on the designs like I used to. And at home... I don't know, I start things and just leave them half-finished. I'm just so distracted all the time. It's... it's making the arguments worse, honestly. Because I'm not really there.
Do you feel like your worries are interfering with your overall well-being or daily life?

Yeah... I mean, I just told you about work and home. It's... it's definitely interfering. Like I said, my manager is writing up those missed details now. And... the stuff at home. I just leave things half-done. I'm too distracted, and... it just makes the arguments worse. So... yeah. It's interfering.
Would you say that your worries are causing you a lot of distress?
I mean... yeah. I guess so. It's just... hard to deal with. But... yeah, I suppose it is.
Did something specific happen around the time your worries started getting worse about nine months ago?

Yeah, I guess... it's been about nine months. That's when... well, work got really intense. The cloud migration project ramped up. And... I don't know, that's also around the time the arguments at home started happening all the time. So... yeah. About nine months.
Do you think your worries would decrease if the stressful situations at work and home were to improve?
I don't know... maybe? I mean, if things were better, it would probably help. But... I'm not really sure. It just feels like there's always something.
Do you think your worries started or got worse because of the cloud migration project at work or the arguments at home?
I mean... I don't really know. Maybe? It's hard to say if that's exactly why it all got worse. They just... kind of happened around the same time. I'm not really sure.
Do you worry about the same things when you are alone as when you are with your family or at work?
Um... yeah, I guess. It doesn't really seem to matter where I am, or... who's around. It's pretty much the same. Just... always there.
Do you think your worries would go away if all the stressful situations in your life were resolved?
I don't think so... I mean, I guess it's possible, but... even when things are quiet, I just find something else to stress about. It never really stops.
Do you think your worries are mostly about the cloud migration project at work or the arguments at home, or are they more general and not focused on any one thing?

I mean... it's not just one thing. It's... kind of everything at once. The work project, the fighting at home... but also the bills, the house stuff I can't seem to finish. I just keep thinking I'm messing everything up... at work, as a husband, as a dad. It's just... all of it.
